faqs.question: Can I Reserve A Truck Remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. We Can Share Extra Photos, Arrange A Video Walkaround And Hold The Truck After Final Availability Checks And An Agreed Deposit.

faqs.question: Can I View A Truck Before I Buy?
faqs.answer: Yes. Viewings Are By Appointment At Our Yard In Little Wigston, Swadlincote, DE12 7BJ, So The Truck And Its Paperwork Are Ready When You Arrive.

faqs.question: Can I Part Exchange My Vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send The Registration, Mileage, Condition Notes And Photos So The Team Can Prepare A Valuation.

faqs.question: Do Prices Include VAT?
faqs.answer: Each Listing Shows Whether The Price Is Plus VAT, VAT Included Or No VAT. Final VAT Status Is Confirmed On The Invoice Before Payment.

faqs.question: Do You Show MOT And Clean Air Zone Information?
faqs.answer: Listings Include MOT Status And Euro/CAZ Notes Where Available. Buyers Should Still Check Registration-specific Details Before Use.
